QuestInfo.name: [Spring Event] Beautiful Rice Cake Dish
QuestInfo.0: You collected all the Rice Cakes that Lady Spring Bunny made, and you've got quite a lot. You probably won't be able to finish them on your own... How about bringing some back to her?\r\n\r\n#e#bCan be repeated up to 10 times each day.#k
QuestInfo.1: Lady Spring Bunny seems pretty touched that you brought some back. She wants you to surprise her mom with a beautiful dish of Rice Cakes.\r\n\r\n#e#bCan be repeated up to 10 times each day#k
QuestInfo.2: Lady Spring Bunny put together all the Rice Cakes to make a beautiful dish. Happy Thanksgiving!

0.0: Hm? Rice Cakes? Wait, you saved them for me?

yes.0: Wow! I'm so touched! To be honest, I was short on them... Not only do I have a lot of family members, they all have a pretty big appetite. And you saved us from running out! Mommy will be super happy when she sees all the Rice Cakes I made!

no.0: Whaaaat, I got stoked for nothing... Go away if you don't have anything to say.
